statement: A change of an app document that adds or widens an ALLOW of a permission policy names the tenant documents the back-reference index lists as binding that policy in the app, as one informational entry per policy (CTL-48), without reading a tenant document; the entry never stands in for the escalation the widening needs (the change also carries NOT_ANALYZED), so a person still approves it.
guards: control:ChangesB1Test#widening an app permission policy lists the tenant bindings it widens - RC1-34
